name: Wheat
description: Major staple food crop of Uttar Pradesh, heavily cultivated across western and eastern UP plains.

name: Rice / Paddy
description: Primary Kharif crop grown extensively in eastern UP, Terai region, and central districts.

name: Sugarcane
description: Uttar Pradesh is India's leading sugarcane producer, dominant in western UP and Terai belt.

name: Potato
description: Agra, Farrukhabad, and Kannauj regions in UP are major potato production hubs.

name: Maize
description: Widely grown cereal crop across central and eastern districts of UP.

name: Mustard
description: Essential oilseed crop cultivated widely in Bundelkhand, western, and central UP.

name: Chickpea / Gram
description: Important pulse crop grown predominantly in Bundelkhand and southern UP districts.

name: Pigeon Pea / Arhar
description: Major pulse crop cultivated in central, eastern, and southern regions of Uttar Pradesh.

name: Lentil
description: Vital pulse crop grown across flood plains and eastern UP districts.

name: Pea
description: Cultivated both for green vegetable pods and dry pulse across UP plains.

name: Tomato
description: Widely grown horticultural crop vulnerable to fungal blights and wilt.

name: Chili
description: Important spice crop susceptible to leaf curl virus and anthracnose.

name: Brinjal / Eggplant
description: Popular solanaceous vegetable grown across UP market gardens.

name: Okra / Bhindi
description: Key commercial vegetable crop prone to yellow vein mosaic virus.

name: Mango
description: Malihabad (Lucknow) and Saharanpur are world-famous UP mango belts.
